title: Why Looski founder Kevin Loo chose Every to incorporate his startup
summary: Looski founder Kevin Loo shares why he chose Every to incorporate, how he set up banking, and what he expects to need as he hires.
body_markdown:
## Key takeaways


- Kevin Loo started Looski to help companies in compliance-heavy industries run AI on infrastructure they control. The idea grew out of a conversation with someone running a medical company who felt that model restrictions and retirements were making it harder to rely on AI in her own business.
- When Kevin set up Looski, he needed to incorporate, open a bank account, and buy hardware to test.
- What stood out about Every was how quickly he could move from getting funded to using a card for those purchases.


## Why did you choose Every?


**Kevin Loo:** Yeah, one of the reasons I chose Every is that it's just a very integrated experience. I get to have have deposit go right into banking and then be able to expense it on a card. I was I walked out of Microsoft with a lot of hardware that I needed to test pretty much all within the same week. And that that was important to me.


## What alternatives did you consider?


**Kevin Loo:** I've incorporated most of my companies through Incfile. I just am not a fan of with how much they're pushing other products to you and Yeah, just just not a fan of those overall experience. With Every were just much smoother and I think Incorporation as as a wedge into a founder's journey i is a great way to do it. That it's well done there.


## How did incorporation go?


**Kevin Loo:** It's great. I just sent in the application and I think a couple of days later I got the EIN couple of days later the bank got approved. And I was in talks with Raising from a V C and like pretty much as I closed that round, banking got approved.


## What other Every products do you expect to use?


**Kevin Loo:** Yeah, banking right away I needed it. bookkeeping payroll not of yet. Majority of my purchases are just going to hardware for me to test and I don't plan to draw a wage. but as I as I need to hire, as I finish my next round, that that that will become a need.


## Tell us about Looski.


**Kevin Loo:** So there are a lot of restri constraints on the adoption of these compliance first companies. And essentially what Looski does is it helps companies either host their own own AI in in private cloud or host them directly on premise.
